transcript: Last night my sister and I saw One Woman Show Downtown at the Greenwich House Theater, written and performed by Liz Kingsman. One Woman Show is kind of difficult to describe. It's satirical, a parody of many jokes exemplified by the young adults stumbling their way through their 20s, and it's also a parody of autobiographical storytelling in general. Liz sense of humor and style of narration are uniquely clever and self aware, and her delivery is great as well. Overall, it's quite good at a breezy 75 minutes. Currently running through August 11th with that, another program for my collection.
